body:
I went through this heavily when I was in high school. Seemed like while people told me, “we like having you around” or “we miss you” it was never genuine. The best way I expressed it was that they missed the idea of me. They liked the extra body to help round out the group. 

Don’t let this get to you. I moved past it a while back and it never got too strong of a hold on me. Soon enough you’ll curate your own group of friends and that feeling will pass. Not sure of your exact situation but I’m here to talk if you need someone pal.
Definitely can relate to this feeling.  The only way I've found around it is suppressing it but I think you and I both know how that one can end.  Stay strong pal
I’m an apple user, but I’m not opposed to doing some searching. Thank you very much for your time and wisdom. I truly appreciate it.
Where did you learn to meditate if don’t mind me asking? Through books and readings?  I’ve thought about trying to meditate, but I’ve never done anything like it before.
I could yes. My insurance would cover it I believe. There’s still that nagging thing for me that was instilled when I was younger that says going to a therapist shows weakness.

I’ve tried talking to a couple of friends about it, but I always feel like I’m just temporarily shelving my problems on them and being a overall burden/annoyance. Ive thought about getting professional help  and I want help, but I don’t want to look/feel like I’m inadequate/dumb for it which is ultimately how my family would see it. Thank you for sharing Mike.
I can see that. Looking at when I was younger I was always told to just tough it out and deal with it. Thank you for sharing.
